## [1.3.0](https://github.com/sahilwasgood/patches/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0) (2026-10-18)

### ✨ New Features

* header packs patch matched to the logo packs ([2285ef4](https://github.com/sahilwasgood/patches/commit/2285ef41d7d505ac236a79ca02f290fb8dcea55c))

patches.name: Header packs
patches.description: Applies a preset header logo matched to the logo packs. Turn off Morphe's Change header patch, both replace the same header resources. Stock leaves the header untouched.

patches.name: Logo packs
patches.description: Applies a preset app icon (all packs incl. Vanced Light). Turn off Morphe's Custom branding patch, both set the launcher icon.

patches.name: Header packs
patches.description: Applies a preset header logo (top left) matched to the logo packs. Turn off Morphe's Change header patch, both replace the same header resources. Stock leaves the header untouched.

patches.name: Logo packs
patches.description: Applies a preset app icon (all packs incl. Vanced Light). Turn off Morphe's Custom branding patch, both set the launcher icon. Use Custom icon with a folder for your own art.

patches.name: Overlay button style
patches.description: Player overlay button style (Bold, Rounded, Thin). Covers different buttons than Morphe's Player icon style, keep both on. Files that reference renamed drawables are skipped, so new app versions degrade to fewer styled buttons instead of failing.

patches.name: Shorts button style
patches.description: Shorts action button style. Stock leaves the app untouched. Turn off Morphe's Shorts icon style patch, both style the same buttons.
